title: Netflix signs commercial distribution deal with EverPass for expanded NFL games
dek: Netflix has reached a multiyear agreement with EverPass Media to distribute its NFL games to bars, restaurants, and other commercial establishments. The deal extends Netflix's out-of-home footprint as streaming platforms compete for sports audiences.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Netflix signed a multiyear agreement with EverPass Media to distribute its expanded NFL package to commercial venues including bars and restaurants.
bottom_line: The completion of DAZN's acquisition of EverPass and its rebrand to DAZN for Business will determine whether Netflix's commercial distribution gains are sustained or restructured during the transition. The deal establishes Netflix's commitment to out-of-home metrics as a core component of its sports strategy.
body:
Netflix has signed a multiyear agreement with EverPass Media to distribute its NFL games to commercial establishments including bars and restaurants, according to Front Office Sports reporting on September 1. The deal covers Netflix's expanded NFL rights package.
EverPass previously distributed Netflix's NFL Christmas Day games as well as live boxing matches shown on the service. DirecTV for Business will market, sell, and distribute Netflix's NFL games alongside other sports content available through EverPass.
Netflix's expanded NFL slate includes a Week 1 game from Australia between the 49ers and Rams, the league's first-ever Thanksgiving Eve game, two additional games on Christmas, a critical Week 18 matchup with playoff implications, and the NFL Honors awards program.
The EverPass distribution infrastructure comes as the company undergoes a significant transition. EverPass is being acquired by London-based DAZN, and the closing of that acquisition is expected after receiving needed regulatory approvals, per Front Office Sports. EverPass will ultimately rebrand itself to DAZN for Business as part of the acquisition deal. DirecTV and EverPass recently reached their own contract extension.
Amazon already has a pact in place with EverPass for commercial distribution of sports content. The NFL's 32 Equity arm and RedBird Capital Partners originally formed EverPass in 2023.
Out-of-home viewership metrics proved particularly impactful during the recent FIFA men's World Cup.
